# Receipt

The voter's proof of tracking: a wallet-style pass on screen and a plain slip on paper. It carries a tracking code and nothing that reveals the vote.

**Mode:** voter. The paper version is generated by `tools/receipts`.

## Contents

Exactly what the receipt mockup in `vibing-out/vbt` `docs/voter-journey.md` lists, in that order:

1. County, election name and date.
2. Precinct.
3. "Your ballot tracking code:" and the code.
4. QR code that opens `/track/<code>`.
5. Tracking address, phone line, phone code, text instructions.
6. "This code shows your ballot's progress. It does not show how you voted."

**Never:** choices, time of voting, sequence number, machine ID, voter name.

## Screen: the receipt pass

Shown after scanning or entering a code (an "Add to my ballots" view) and in demos of the voting flow.

- `surface-inverse` card, `radius-lg`, `shadow-overlay`, max 380px wide.
- Top band: county and election in `on-inverse-muted` `label` style; StatusBadge on the right.
- Middle: the code in `code-lg`, `on-inverse`, groups never split.
- A perforation: a row of small cut-out half circles on both edges and a dotted `on-inverse-muted` rule at 30% opacity. Decorative only.
- Bottom: QR code on a white rounded tile (`surface-raised` light value) so it scans, plus "Precinct 12 · Nov 3, 2026".
- Footer line in `on-inverse-muted`: the "does not show how you voted" sentence.
- Actions under the pass, outside the card: "Track this ballot" (primary) and "Save image" (secondary). Saving is safe and says so.

## Paper: the slip

- Black only on white or colored slip stock; no gray tints (thermal printers band them).
- Width fits an 80mm thermal roll; content in a single column with 4mm margins.
- Code in JetBrains Mono 14pt weight 500; QR code at least 25mm with a 4-module quiet zone.
- Headings in Instrument Sans 10pt bold; everything else 9pt or larger.
- A dashed cut line is allowed on paper; it's functional there.

## Accessibility

- The on-screen pass is a `section` with a heading ("Your ballot receipt"), not an image.
- The code is selectable text with a "Copy code" button that announces "Code copied".
- The QR image has alt text "QR code for tracking code RIVER-MAPLE-7Q4K-HAWK".
- Contrast pairs: `on-inverse` and `on-inverse-muted` on `surface-inverse`.

## Acceptance checks

- [ ] Shows every mockup field and no forbidden field.
- [ ] The QR code scans from the screen at arm's length and from the printed slip.
- [ ] Prints legibly in black only at 80mm.
- [ ] The code reads correctly to a screen reader group by group.
